name: tes
description: A spelling trainer for kids learning English (Taiwan 國中 2000-word list). Built for phonics (自然拼音) learners who read fine but struggle to **spell**. All ~2000 words are graded into **5 levels**; a short **placement test** finds where the student belongs, then it plays as a **level-up game** — practice a level, and once your accuracy passes **80%** you can take the **level challenge** to climb to the next one. Every word shows its **Chinese meaning, KK phonetic, and an example sentence**. Audio, spaced repetition, and a progress dashboard throughout.
